limitations: NO_EARLY_EXERCISE_MODEL: American-style exercise is not modeled; every payoff is a European-style terminal value at expiration only.
NO_FILL_PROBABILITY_MODEL: conservative side-aware entry prices are not a guaranteed fill.
NO_EXPECTED_VALUE_DISTRIBUTION: payoff geometry and IV context are retained without a justified probability model -- see EXPECTED_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE.
NO_PROBABILITY_OF_PROFIT_FIELD: option delta is not represented as a probability anywhere in this module.

FEE_EVIDENCE_MAY_BE_INCOMPLETE: see the bound fee policy's fee_evidence_status -- a FEE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE policy uses a clearly-labeled conservative research assumption, not a confirmed provider rate.
SINGLE_QUANTITY_V1: position sizing beyond a small fixed contract quantity per leg is not modeled this milestone.
NO_IV_REGIME_SCORING: high/low implied volatility is never scored as automatically favorable for a credit or debit structure; that relationship is left to later research.
